name: Being A Soldier
overview: Scripture portrays the believer as a soldier called to courage and strength, assured of God's presence and victory amid spiritual battles. Joshua 1:9 encourages steadfastness and fearlessness because the Lord is always with His people, while Psalms 18:39 affirms that God empowers His followers to overcome their adversaries. John 16:33 offers peace through Christ’s triumph over the world, enabling believers to face tribulation with confidence. Romans 13:4 reminds us that authority serves God's purpose in maintaining justice, and Ephesians 6:13 exhorts believers to don the full armor of God to stand firm against evil, emphasizing preparedness and perseverance in the spiritual fight.
